components.name: Card surface
components.description: 0build surface for mobile game records and the filter panel.

narrative.overview: 0build's dark, compact component system supports a game-comparison task. Tables and native controls lead; cards adapt the rankings to small screens. The system is intentionally conventional and information-dense, as approved in issue #39.
dos: Do reuse 0build classes and tokens; keep application-specific layout in the styles cascade layer.
Do preserve native keyboard behavior, skip links, visible focus and readable dark-theme options.
Do verify actual computed contrast when upgrading the vendor pin.
donts: Don't replace component foundations with lookalike CSS or add a JavaScript runtime for CSS-only controls.
Don't trade dense, readable game facts for decorative metrics or truncate long game names.
Don't load UI dependencies from runtime CDNs.
